_comment: 2026-11-25 /change: owner decisions on docs/design-plan-2026-11.md. Free during beta with limits; tabs 9 -> 6; 'Connection keys'; celebrations on with an off switch. One feature per session, in this order.

requirements.text: Codeceipt is free during the beta, with clear per-account limits, and every page says the same thing
Every page is easy to understand for non-engineers and pleasant to use (docs/design-plan-2026-11.md)

features.title: Free beta with limits: one price story everywhere

acceptance.check: With BETA_LIMITS=on and billing not configured, an account owning 3 projects can open them all, and creating a 4th (dashboard form, /device approval or /github/select) returns 402 with the message 'The free beta includes 3 projects. Delete one or wait for paid plans.'

With BETA_LIMITS=on, the 100th receipt of a UTC calendar month across the account's projects is AI-checked; the 101st is still made from git and says 'Not AI-checked: the beta's 100 a month are used. Resets on the 1st.'

Landing hero, FAQ, /pricing and /terms all say 'Free during the beta' with the same limits (3 projects, 100 AI-checked receipts a month); no paid plan, price or checkout button is rendered while BETA_LIMITS=on; Pricing is linked in the public header and footer
/account shows 'Free beta: N of 3 projects, M of 100 AI-checked receipts this month (resets on the 1st)'

Limits are counted on the server from the session's account; a projectId, plan or count sent by the client, a project token, or a second browser session cannot raise them (attacker test for each create route)
With BETA_LIMITS unset and billing not configured (self-hosted, tests), no project or receipt limit applies (D-029 unchanged)

features.notes: Limits live in packages/core/src/plans.ts as a 'beta' plan; update D-029 in docs/decisions.md and .env.example. Set BETA_LIMITS=on in Vercel after it ships.

features.title: Shared design foundations: dates, confirm dialog, mobile menu, glossary

acceptance.check: Dates in the dashboard, account and admin read 'Today 14:19', 'yesterday' or '3 days ago' in the viewer's time zone with the full date on hover; no page renders 'UTC' or a raw ISO date
One ConfirmDialog (consequence sentence, danger style, focus trapped, Escape cancels) is used for every destructive action; apps/web/src contains no window.confirm
At 375 px a Menu button in the header opens Docs, Account and Sign out; Account is also in the footer
The header and mobile menu show Admin only to logins in ADMIN_GITHUB_LOGINS; other users never see the link and /admin still answers 404 for them
Glossary terms (receipt, blueprint, checklist item, connection key, RLS, MCP) have a dotted underline whose one-sentence tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus, and /glossary lists them all
Project and admin tab rows at 375 px show a fade at the scroll edge and scroll the active tab into view

features.title: Trust fixes: things that look broken today

acceptance.check: No rendered page contains '[REVIEW]' or '[SCREENSHOT' (privacy, terms, quickstart)
Onboarding steps read 1 'Connect this computer' (done when linked), 2 'Codeceipt reads your project' (done when indexed), 3 'Get your first receipt'; a step before a done step always shows done
Receipt summaries hide zero counts, show 'All done' when nothing is wrong, and use correct singular/plural ('1 security problem')
A user with an active paid plan who tries to delete the account sees 'Cancel your plan in Manage billing first' with the billing button, not 'Reload the page'
After an admin suspends or restores a user the status badge updates without a reload; AI usage shows unit costs with 3-4 decimals
The CLI's last line says 'npx codeceipt last' when started with npx; the Suspended page's Contact support is a working link; the Connect tab's keys link opens the keys page
A project shows the tabs Overview, Receipts, Features, To decide, Blueprint, Settings; Receipts and To decide show a count badge when something waits
Settings holds Connect, Connection keys (renamed from Tokens everywhere), approval presets and pause, and Delete project
Old URLs (/plan, /proposals, /approvals, /connect, the Tokens page) redirect to their new place with a 308
A signed-in user who does not own the project gets 404 on every new tab and redirect target, and badge counts never include another user's data

features.title: Onboarding: from sign-in to the first receipt without confusion

acceptance.check: /start shows exactly one current step with a 'Waiting for…' line, one primary action per state, and a 'Never used a terminal?' helper including 'paste this into Claude Code or Cursor'
/device with an expired or used code shows 'This code expired or was already used. Run npx codeceipt again' before any form
/device explains in plain words what approving allows and that source code stays on the computer; after approval it links to Get started
The first receipt shows 'Your first receipt is here', one summary sentence and one next action; the print animation runs once and not under prefers-reduced-motion
The device approval still requires the signed-in owner's explicit Approve; a code passed in the URL alone never links a computer (attacker test)
The headline and next step are one block with one primary button; the headline count equals the number of receipts in the list under it
Stat cards use plain labels ('Security problems', 'Things your agent missed', 'Built as asked') and each opens the receipts list already filtered to its items
With nothing needing attention the page shows 'All clear. Everything your agents did this week checks out'; at 375 px stats are a 2x2 grid
Filter links and counts only ever include the signed-in owner's project data

features.title: Receipts: a sentence first, details on request

acceptance.check: Each receipt summary shows a verdict sentence and at most 3 badges; SHAs, paths and package names sit in the body or under Technical details
The feed groups receipts as Needs you / Agent is fixing / All good; 'Copy fix for your agent' copies the prompt and confirms 'Copied. Paste it into Claude Code or Cursor.'
A search or filter with no matches shows 'No receipts match … Clear search'; '?' opens the shortcut sheet
A receipt with every item done prints an 'All N items done' stamp once; Account has a switch that turns celebrations off and it is respected on every page
Text from receipts (requests, file names) is shown as text, never as HTML; a request containing <script> renders literally

features.title: Features and Plan in plain words

acceptance.check: A feature's status agrees with its progress (any done item means at least 'In progress'); stats are the filter chips; rows open a feature page with its receipts and items
Plan shows 'Must' / 'Must never' with icons instead of [positive]/[negative], appears as a banner on Features when a draft waits, and offers 'Not right? Tell your agent what to change.'
At 375 px features show as cards, not a 6-column table
A feature page of another user's project answers 404

features.title: To decide: one inbox for approvals and proposals

acceptance.check: Approval requests and proposals share one list; each card has Approve and Reject, a 'Remember my choice' checkbox, actions written as sentences and 'expires in N hours'
Proposals show the old text struck through and the new text, plus the agent's reason; Reject asks 'Why not? (optional)' and the reason reaches the agent
Approve and reject still require the owner's session; a project token or another user cannot approve (attacker test per action)
An expired request cannot be approved and says 'This request expired'

features.title: Blueprint, Safety check and History for non-engineers

acceptance.check: Rules read as plain sentences grouped 'It does' / 'It must never'; formal wording appears only in Full detail; no all-caps rule text
A summary line and one health sentence per feature with one action; Safety check and History have their own title, purpose sentence and breadcrumbs
Safety risks are written for people; SQL and file paths sit under Technical details; Discover has a 'Confirm this feature' button with progress
Restoring an old version asks through ConfirmDialog and never deletes newer versions

features.title: Account, connection keys, admin and suspended pages

acceptance.check: Account shows the plan card with usage, 'Connection keys' with copy-once secret and relative dates, and 'Signed-in browsers' with a 'This browser' pill
Suspending a user states the consequences, takes an optional reason shown in the audit log, and uses danger style; admin overview leads with one status sentence
Every admin page and action still answers 404 to non-admins (attacker test)
'Sign out everywhere' asks 'including this browser?' before acting

features.title: Public pages: landing, pricing, quickstart, shared receipt, 404

acceptance.check: The landing hero shows the first step in order ('1. Run this in your app's folder', then 'Already set up? Sign in'); the page has at most 6 sections before the FAQ
Quickstart uses the same 3 steps as the landing page with the working command first and numbered troubleshooting
A shared receipt page has the public header and footer, a title, a purpose sentence and a state legend
A signed-out visitor on a 404 gets 'Home' as the primary action; a dead share link says to ask the sender for a new one
Every public page passes at 375 and 1280 px in light and dark with no horizontal scroll
